svg.title: RL Token and FlexRLT: ManiSkill success rates
svg.desc: Complete training and evaluation records for the RL-token TD3 policy on eight GPUs and three FlexRLT runs on four GPUs. All runs use 64 training and 256 evaluation environments. Training overlays the trailing 20-step mean on raw rates; evaluation plots every recorded checkpoint. Each vertical axis begins at the lowest recorded success rate.

g.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
